FROM args
JOIN base_players bp ON $278
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.player_id = bp.id
LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id = bp.id
WHERE b.player_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.projection_fantasy_points DESC NULLS LAST, bp.display_name ASC, bp.id ASC
LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)

(
  WITH context AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT trade.id,league.id AS league_id,season.id AS season_id,season.season_year,
      league.roster_size,league.scoring_settings,league.faab_starting_budget,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.league_members member WHERE member.league_id=league.id) AS teams,
      queued.averages_initialized
    FROM public.trades trade JOIN public.leagues league ON league.id=trade.league_id AND league.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN public.league_seasons season ON season.league_id=league.id AND season.is_current
    LEFT JOIN private.screen_refresh_queue queued ON queued.league_season_id=season.id
    WHERE trade.id=p_trade_id AND trade.status IN ($2,$3)
  ), assets AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT item.* FROM public.trade_items item WHERE item.trade_id=p_trade_id
  )
  SELECT md5(jsonb_build_array($4,to_jsonb(context),
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(source,scope,revision) ORDER BY source,scope) FROM (
      SELECT source,scope,sum(revision)+CASE WHEN source=$5 AND scope=$6
        THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting($7,$8),$9)::bigint,$10)-$11,$12) ELSE $13 END AS revision
      FROM private.trade_input_revisions
      WHERE scope IN ($14,context.league_id::text,context.season_id::text) GROUP BY source,scope) versions),
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(from_member_id,to_member_id,player_id,pick_id,faab_amount) ORDER BY id) FROM assets),
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pick.id,pick.season_year,pick.round,pick.current_owner_id,pick.original_owner_id,
      member.team_name,slot.pick_in_round,pick.predicted_trade_value,pick.predicted_value_bands,
      pick.prediction_version,pick.prediction_source_sha256) ORDER BY pick.id)
      FROM public.draft_picks pick JOIN public.league_members member ON member.id=pick.original_owner_id
      LEFT JOIN public.snake_draft_picks slot ON slot.draft_pick_id=pick.id
      WHERE pick.id IN(SELECT pick_id FROM assets)),
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(member.id,COALESCE(balance.balance,context.faab_starting_budget)) ORDER BY member.id)
      FROM public.league_members member LEFT JOIN public.faab_balances balance
        ON balance.member_id=member.id AND balance.league_season_id=context.season_id
      WHERE member.league_id=context.league_id AND member.id IN(SELECT from_member_id FROM assets)),
    (now() AT TIME ZONE $15)::date,
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.dynasty_rankings WHERE fetched_at<=now()),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.dynasty_rankings WHERE fetched_at<now()-interval $16),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.fantasypros_projection_rows WHERE fetched_at<=now()),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.fantasypros_projection_rows WHERE fetched_at<now()-interval $17),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.fantasypros_projection_rows WHERE fetched_at<now()-interval $18),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows WHERE fetched_at<=now()),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows WHERE fetched_at<now()-interval $19),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.player_projections WHERE fetched_at<=now()),
    (SELECT max(fetched_at) FROM public.player_projections WHERE fetched_at<now()-interval $20),
    (SELECT max(game_time) FROM public.nba_games WHERE game_time<=now()),
    (SELECT max(started_at) FROM public.nba_games WHERE started_at<=now())
  )::text) FROM context)

SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(candidate.player_id),$29)                      FROM (
    SELECT average.player_id FROM (
      SELECT player_id,league_id,season_year,avg_fantasy_points FROM public.player_season_averages
        WHERE league_id=league.id AND season_year=season.season_year AND EXISTS(
          SELECT $30 FROM private.screen_refresh_queue WHERE league_season_id=season.id AND averages_initialized)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT player_id,league.id,season.season_year,avg_fantasy_points
        FROM private.trade_value_fantasy_averages(league.id,season.season_year) WHERE NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT $31 FROM private.screen_refresh_queue WHERE league_season_id=season.id AND averages_initialized)
    ) average
    JOIN public.players player ON player.id=average.player_id AND player.nba_team IS NOT NULL
    WHERE average.league_id=league.id AND average.season_year=season.season_year
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT $32 FROM public.roster_players roster WHERE roster.league_id=league.id
        AND roster.league_season_id=season.id AND roster.player_id=average.player_id)
    ORDER BY average.avg_fantasy_points DESC,average.player_id LIMIT $33
  ) candidate

WITH rounded AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT stats.player_id,round(avg(round(COALESCE(stats.points*weights.points,$25) +
        COALESCE(stats.rebounds*weights.rebounds,$26) +
        COALESCE(stats.assists*weights.assists,$27) +
        COALESCE(stats.steals*weights.steals,$28) +
        COALESCE(stats.blocks*weights.blocks,$29) +
        COALESCE(stats.turnovers*weights.turnovers,$30) +
        COALESCE(stats.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made,$31) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made,$32) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted,$33) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made,$34) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted,$35) +
        CASE WHEN stats.double_double THEN COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,$36) ELSE $37 END +
        CASE WHEN stats.triple_double THEN COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,$38) ELSE $39 END,$40)),$41) AS average
    FROM unnest(game_ids) AS game(id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT stats.* FROM public.player_game_stats stats
      WHERE stats.game_id=game.id AND stats.player_id=ANY(rounded_players)
        AND stats.season_year=p_season_year AND NOT stats.did_not_play
      OFFSET $42
    ) stats
    GROUP BY stats.player_id
  )
  SELECT totals.player_id,CASE WHEN totals.player_id=ANY(rounded_players) THEN rounded.average
    ELSE round((totals.points*weights.points +
      totals.rebounds*weights.rebounds +
      totals.assists*weights.assists +
      totals.steals*weights.steals +
      totals.blocks*weights.blocks +
      totals.turnovers*weights.turnovers +
      totals.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made +
      totals.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made +
      totals.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted +
      totals.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made +
      totals.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted +
      CASE WHEN totals.double_double>$43 THEN totals.double_double*COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,$44) ELSE $45 END +
      CASE WHEN totals.triple_double>$46 THEN totals.triple_double*COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,$47) ELSE $48 END)/NULLIF(totals.games_played,$49),$50) END
    FROM analytics.player_season_totals totals LEFT JOIN rounded ON rounded.player_id=totals.player_id
    WHERE totals.season_year=p_season_year AND (p_player_ids IS NULL OR totals.player_id=ANY(p_player_ids))

inputs:=private.build_trade_estimate_inputs(p_user_id,p_member_id,terms,false)
    ||jsonb_build_object('revaluationTradeId',p_trade_id,'pickPredictionVersions',(
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pick.id,pick.prediction_version,pick.prediction_source_sha256) ORDER BY pick.id)
      FROM public.draft_picks pick JOIN public.trade_items item ON item.pick_id=pick.id WHERE item.trade_id=p_trade_id))

player_input_rows:=private.trade_value_player_inputs(league.id,p_member_id,season.season_year,
      ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(player_ids||replacement_ids) id ORDER BY id),105)

(
  WITH input_rows AS (
WITH authorized AS (
  SELECT 1
    FROM public.league_members AS own_member
   WHERE own_member.id = p_member_id
     AND own_member.league_id = p_league_id
     AND own_member.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
),
candidate_ids AS (
  SELECT ranking.player_id, min(ranking.source_rank) AS sort_rank
    FROM authorized
    JOIN public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
      ON ranking.source IN (
        'hashtagbasketball.com',
        'hashtagbasketball.com/points-3',
        'hashtagbasketball.com/rookie'
      )
     AND ranking.player_id IS NOT NULL
   WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL
   GROUP BY ranking.player_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT requested.player_id, NULL::int
    FROM authorized
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT player_id
        FROM unnest(p_player_ids) AS ids(player_id)
    ) AS requested
   WHERE p_player_ids IS NOT NULL
),
bounded_players AS (
  SELECT
    player.id,
    COALESCE(player.display_name, concat_ws(' ', player.first_name, player.last_name)) AS display_name,
    player.nba_team,
    player.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(player.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    player.injury_status,
    player.years_exp,
    player.headshot_url,
    player.nba_id,
    five_year.id AS dynasty_ranking_id,
    five_year.source_rank AS five_year_rank,
    three_year.source_rank AS three_year_rank,
    rookie.source_rank AS rookie_rank,
    five_year.rank_change,
    five_year.age,
    five_year.source AS ranking_source,
    five_year.fetched_at AS ranking_fetched_at,
    five_year.trade_value
  FROM candidate_ids AS candidate
  JOIN public.players AS player ON player.id = candidate.player_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.id, ranking.source_rank, ranking.rank_change, ranking.age, ranking.source, ranking.fetched_at, ranking.trade_value
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = 'hashtagbasketball.com'
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT 1
  ) AS five_year ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.source_rank
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = 'hashtagbasketball.com/points-3'
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT 1
  ) AS three_year ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.source_rank
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = 'hashtagbasketball.com/rookie'
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT 1
  ) AS rookie ON true
  WHERE true
     OR player.display_name ILIKE '%' || trim('') || '%'
  ORDER BY candidate.sort_rank NULLS LAST, player.display_name, player.id
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 600), 1), 1000)
  OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE(0, 0), 0)
),
bounded_ids AS (
  SELECT array_agg(id ORDER BY id) AS player_ids
    FROM bounded_players
),
projections AS (
  SELECT projection.*
    FROM bounded_ids AS ids
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.get_league_projection_rows(
      p_league_id,
      p_season_year,
      (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date,
      'today',
      ids.player_ids,
      1000,
      0
    ) AS projection
   WHERE ids.player_ids IS NOT NULL
),
fantasy_averages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points
    FROM private.trade_value_fantasy_averages(p_league_id,p_season_year,p_player_ids)
)
SELECT
  player.id AS player_id,
  player.display_name,
  player.nba_team,
  player.position,
  player.eligible_positions,
  player.injury_status,
  player.years_exp,
  player.headshot_url,
  player.nba_id,
  player.dynasty_ranking_id,
  player.five_year_rank,
  player.three_year_rank,
  player.rookie_rank,
  player.rank_change,
  player.age,
  player.ranking_source,
  player.ranking_fetched_at,
  average.games_played,
  average.avg_points,
  average.avg_rebounds,
  average.avg_assists,
  average.avg_steals,
  average.avg_blocks,
  average.avg_three_pointers_made,
  average.avg_turnovers,
  average.avg_field_goals_made,
  average.avg_field_goals_attempted,
  average.avg_free_throws_made,
  average.avg_free_throws_attempted,
  fantasy.avg_fantasy_points,
  projection.projection_fantasy_points,
  projection.projection_fetched_at,
  projection.projection_source,
  player.trade_value
FROM bounded_players AS player
LEFT JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages AS average
  ON average.player_id = player.id
 AND average.season_year = p_season_year
LEFT JOIN fantasy_averages AS fantasy
  ON fantasy.player_id = player.id
LEFT JOIN projections AS projection ON projection.player_id = player.id
ORDER BY player.five_year_rank NULLS LAST, player.display_name, player.id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(player) || CASE WHEN market.id IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    'dynasty_ranking_id', market.id,
    'five_year_rank', market.source_rank,
    'rank_change', market.rank_change,
    'age', market.age,
    'ranking_source', market.source,
    'ranking_fetched_at', market.fetched_at,
    'trade_value', market.trade_value
  ) END ORDER BY player.player_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM input_rows player
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.id, ranking.source_rank, ranking.rank_change, ranking.age, ranking.source, ranking.fetched_at, ranking.trade_value
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.player_id AND ranking.source = 'onenumberhoops.com'
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT 1
  ) market ON true)

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN p_view IN ('today', 'week_avg', 'week_total') THEN p_view ELSE 'today' END AS view_name,
    COALESCE(p_game_date, (timezone('America/New_York', now()))::date) AS game_date,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 600), 1), 1000) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0) AS page_offset
),
league AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    scoring_settings,
    (
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'field_goals_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_made')::numeric, 0) <> 0 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>'free_throws_attempted')::numeric, 0) <> 0
    ) AS uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  FROM public.leagues
  WHERE id = p_league_id
),
week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT 1
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws(' ', p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM public.players p
  WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_player_ids)
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng
    ON ng.game_date >= args.game_date
   AND ng.status NOT IN ('InProgress', 'Final')
   AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT home_team AS nba_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
  ) g ON g.nba_team = teams.nba_team
  ORDER BY teams.nba_team, g.game_date ASC, g.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, g.id ASC
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN 'vs ' || COALESCE(g.away_team, '?')
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN '@ ' || COALESCE(g.home_team, '?')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = 'fantasypros'
   AND latest_run.projection_type = 'weekly_total'
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = 'success'
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    'fantasypros_daily'::text AS projection_source,
    'FantasyPros Daily'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'today'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    1 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'daily'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '36 hours'
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = 'today'
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'fantasypros_weekly_avg_total'
      ELSE 'fantasypros_weekly_avg'
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'FantasyPros Week Avg x GP'
      ELSE 'FantasyPros Week Avg'
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 'week_total'
      ELSE 'week_avg'
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      NULL::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 2 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' AND m.games_multiplier > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 3 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN 0::numeric
        ELSE NULL::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_avg' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_avg'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = r.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(r.games_played, 0), wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  WHERE args.view_name IN ('today', 'week_avg', 'week_total')
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_total_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    'fantasypros_weekly_total'::text AS projection_source,
    'FantasyPros Week Total'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'week_total'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric, NULL::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, 0) > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 2 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE 0
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, 0) > 0 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, 0) / NULLIF(r.games_played, 0) >= 10)::int
        ) >= 3 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE 0
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    1 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = 'weekly_total'
   AND r.match_status = 'matched'
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval '8 days'
  JOIN latest_weekly_total_run lwtr
    ON lwtr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = 'success'
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = 'week_total'
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
internal_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.player_id)
    pp.player_id,
    'internal'::text AS projection_source,
    'Internal Projection'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'fallback'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_double_doubles, 0) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_double_doubles
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_triple_doubles, 0) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_triple_doubles
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    pp.projected_minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE NULL::int END AS projection_games_played,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status,
    pp.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    NULL::date AS projection_date,
    pp.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    3 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.player_projections pp
    ON pp.season_year = p_season_year
   AND pp.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND pp.projected_stat_points IS NOT NULL
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = pp.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = pp.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  ORDER BY pp.player_id, pp.fetched_at DESC
),
season_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    avg.player_id,
    'season_avg'::text AS projection_source,
    'Season Avg'::text AS projection_source_label,
    'fallback'::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) > 0
        THEN COALESCE(avg.double_doubles, 0)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE 0 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, 0) > 0
        THEN COALESCE(avg.triple_doubles, 0)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE 0 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_minutes_played * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE avg.games_played::int END AS projection_games_played,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    NULL::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status,
    NULL::timestamptz AS projection_fetched_at,
    NULL::date AS projection_date,
    NULL::int AS projection_week_number,
    true AS projection_is_fresh,
    4 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON true
  JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages avg
    ON avg.season_year = p_season_year
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = avg.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = avg.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = 'week_total' THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, 0)::numeric
      ELSE 1::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
),
candidate_union AS (
  SELECT * FROM daily_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_total_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_avg_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM internal_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM season_avg_candidates
),
fallback_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cu.player_id) cu.*
  FROM candidate_union cu
  ORDER BY cu.player_id, cu.priority ASC, cu.projection_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
sleeper_games AS (
  SELECT r.*, public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
    r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
    r.field_goals_made, r.field_goals_attempted, r.free_throws_made, r.free_throws_attempted,
    r.double_doubles, r.triple_doubles, l.scoring_settings
  ) AS fantasy_points, r.team IS DISTINCT FROM bp.nba_team AS prior_team_game
  FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows r
  JOIN base_players bp ON bp.id = r.player_id
  LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id=bp.id
  JOIN league l ON true
  CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON true
  WHERE r.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (r.game_date<(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date OR r.team=bp.nba_team)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
      SELECT game_date,home_team AS team,away_team AS opponent FROM regular_games
      UNION ALL SELECT game_date,away_team,home_team FROM regular_games
    ) g WHERE g.game_date=r.game_date AND g.team=r.team AND g.opponent=r.opponent)
    AND (args.view_name = 'today' AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)
      OR args.view_name <> 'today' AND r.week_number = wc.week_number)
),
sleeper_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id, count(*)::integer AS games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE prior_team_game)::integer AS prior_team_games,
    sum(fantasy_points) AS fantasy_points,
    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    100 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),0) AS field_goal_pct,
    100 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),0) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id
),
sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, 'sleeper'::text AS projection_source, 'Sleeper (RotoWire)'::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor,2) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,0)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,0)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,0)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE 0 END,0) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    NULL::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN s.game_date ELSE NULL::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval '36 hours' AS projection_is_fresh, 0 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name='today' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,0)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,0) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_total' THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,0)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name='week_avg' THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM sleeper_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT b.* FROM fallback_best b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sleeper_candidates s WHERE s.player_id=b.player_id)
)

SELECT
  bp.id AS player_id,
  bp.display_name,
  bp.nba_team,
  bp."position",
  bp.eligible_positions,
  bp.injury_status,
  bp.headshot_url,
  bp.nba_id,
  ng.next_game_date,
  ng.next_game_opponent,
  ng.next_game_time,
  b.projection_source,
  b.projection_source_label,
  b.projection_view,
  b.projection_fantasy_points,
  b.projection_minutes,
  b.projection_points,
  b.projection_rebounds,
  b.projection_assists,
  b.projection_steals,
  b.projection_blocks,
  b.projection_three_pointers_made,
  b.projection_turnovers,
  b.projection_games_played,
  b.projection_field_goal_pct,
  b.projection_free_throw_pct,
  b.projection_status,
  b.projection_fetched_at,
  COALESCE(b.projection_date, ng.next_game_date) AS projection_date,
  b.projection_week_number,
  b.projection_is_fresh
FROM args
JOIN base_players bp ON true
LEFT JOIN best b ON b.player_id = bp.id
LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id = bp.id
WHERE b.player_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.projection_fantasy_points DESC NULLS LAST, bp.display_name ASC, bp.id ASC
LIMIT (SELECT page_limit FROM args)
OFFSET (SELECT page_offset FROM args)

SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(candidate.player_id),'{}')                      FROM (
    SELECT average.player_id FROM (
      SELECT player_id,league_id,season_year,avg_fantasy_points FROM public.player_season_averages
        WHERE league_id=league.id AND season_year=season.season_year AND EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM private.screen_refresh_queue WHERE league_season_id=season.id AND averages_initialized)
      UNION ALL
      SELECT player_id,league.id,season.season_year,avg_fantasy_points
        FROM private.trade_value_fantasy_averages(league.id,season.season_year) WHERE NOT EXISTS(
          SELECT 1 FROM private.screen_refresh_queue WHERE league_season_id=season.id AND averages_initialized)
    ) average
    JOIN public.players player ON player.id=average.player_id AND player.nba_team IS NOT NULL
    WHERE average.league_id=league.id AND average.season_year=season.season_year
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.roster_players roster WHERE roster.league_id=league.id
        AND roster.league_season_id=season.id AND roster.player_id=average.player_id)
    ORDER BY average.avg_fantasy_points DESC,average.player_id LIMIT 5
  ) candidate

WITH rounded AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT stats.player_id,round(avg(round(COALESCE(stats.points*weights.points,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.rebounds*weights.rebounds,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.assists*weights.assists,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.steals*weights.steals,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.blocks*weights.blocks,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.turnovers*weights.turnovers,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made,0) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted,0) +
        CASE WHEN stats.double_double THEN COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN stats.triple_double THEN COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END,2)),2) AS average
    FROM unnest(game_ids) AS game(id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT stats.* FROM public.player_game_stats stats
      WHERE stats.game_id=game.id AND stats.player_id=ANY(rounded_players)
        AND stats.season_year=p_season_year AND NOT stats.did_not_play
      OFFSET 0
    ) stats
    GROUP BY stats.player_id
  )
  SELECT totals.player_id,CASE WHEN totals.player_id=ANY(rounded_players) THEN rounded.average
    ELSE round((totals.points*weights.points +
      totals.rebounds*weights.rebounds +
      totals.assists*weights.assists +
      totals.steals*weights.steals +
      totals.blocks*weights.blocks +
      totals.turnovers*weights.turnovers +
      totals.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made +
      totals.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made +
      totals.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted +
      totals.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made +
      totals.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted +
      CASE WHEN totals.double_double>0 THEN totals.double_double*COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END +
      CASE WHEN totals.triple_double>0 THEN totals.triple_double*COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,0) ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(totals.games_played,0),2) END
    FROM analytics.player_season_totals totals LEFT JOIN rounded ON rounded.player_id=totals.player_id
    WHERE totals.season_year=p_season_year AND (p_player_ids IS NULL OR totals.player_id=ANY(p_player_ids))
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(value)),'[]'::jsonb)                  FROM public.get_dynasty_pick_values(league.id) value

WITH league AS (
    SELECT l.*,s.id AS season_id,s.season_year,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.league_members WHERE league_id=l.id) AS teams
    FROM public.leagues l JOIN public.league_seasons s ON s.league_id=l.id AND s.is_current
    WHERE l.id=p_league_id AND (EXISTS(SELECT $2 FROM public.league_members WHERE league_id=l.id AND user_id=auth.uid())
      OR auth.role()=$3)
  ), available AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT average.player_id,average.avg_fantasy_points FROM league
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL private.trade_value_fantasy_averages(league.id,league.season_year) average
    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT $4 FROM public.roster_players roster
      WHERE roster.league_id=league.id AND roster.league_season_id=league.season_id AND roster.player_id=average.player_id)
  ), replacements AS (
    SELECT ranking.trade_value FROM available
    JOIN public.dynasty_rankings ranking ON ranking.player_id=available.player_id AND ranking.source=$5
    WHERE ranking.trade_value IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY available.avg_fantasy_points DESC,available.player_id LIMIT $6
  ), floor AS (
    SELECT LEAST($7,COALESCE((SELECT avg(trade_value) FROM replacements),
      GREATEST($8,$9*$10/GREATEST($11,teams*roster_size)))) AS value FROM league
  )
  SELECT pick.draft_year,pick.round,pick.tier,CASE WHEN pick.round=$12 THEN GREATEST(pick.trade_value,floor.value)
    ELSE pick.trade_value END,pick.source,pick.fetched_at
  FROM public.dynasty_pick_values pick CROSS JOIN floor ORDER BY pick.draft_year,pick.round,pick.tier

inputs:=private.build_trade_estimate_inputs(p_user_id,p_member_id,terms,$6)
    ||jsonb_build_object($7,p_trade_id,$8,(
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(pick.id,pick.prediction_version,pick.prediction_source_sha256) ORDER BY pick.id)
      FROM public.draft_picks pick JOIN public.trade_items item ON item.pick_id=pick.id WHERE item.trade_id=p_trade_id))

player_input_rows:=private.trade_value_player_inputs(league.id,p_member_id,season.season_year,
      ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(player_ids||replacement_ids) id ORDER BY id),$29)

(
  WITH input_rows AS (
WITH authorized AS (
  SELECT $6
    FROM public.league_members AS own_member
   WHERE own_member.id = p_member_id
     AND own_member.league_id = p_league_id
     AND own_member.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
),
candidate_ids AS (
  SELECT ranking.player_id, min(ranking.source_rank) AS sort_rank
    FROM authorized
    JOIN public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
      ON ranking.source IN (
        $7,
        $8,
        $9
      )
     AND ranking.player_id IS NOT NULL
   WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL
   GROUP BY ranking.player_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT requested.player_id, $10::int
    FROM authorized
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT player_id
        FROM unnest(p_player_ids) AS ids(player_id)
    ) AS requested
   WHERE p_player_ids IS NOT NULL
),
bounded_players AS (
  SELECT
    player.id,
    COALESCE(player.display_name, concat_ws($11, player.first_name, player.last_name)) AS display_name,
    player.nba_team,
    player.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(player.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    player.injury_status,
    player.years_exp,
    player.headshot_url,
    player.nba_id,
    five_year.id AS dynasty_ranking_id,
    five_year.source_rank AS five_year_rank,
    three_year.source_rank AS three_year_rank,
    rookie.source_rank AS rookie_rank,
    five_year.rank_change,
    five_year.age,
    five_year.source AS ranking_source,
    five_year.fetched_at AS ranking_fetched_at,
    five_year.trade_value
  FROM candidate_ids AS candidate
  JOIN public.players AS player ON player.id = candidate.player_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.id, ranking.source_rank, ranking.rank_change, ranking.age, ranking.source, ranking.fetched_at, ranking.trade_value
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = $12
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT $13
  ) AS five_year ON $14
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.source_rank
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = $15
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT $16
  ) AS three_year ON $17
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.source_rank
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings AS ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.id
       AND ranking.source = $18
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT $19
  ) AS rookie ON $20
  WHERE $21
     OR player.display_name ILIKE $22 || trim($23) || $24
  ORDER BY candidate.sort_rank NULLS LAST, player.display_name, player.id
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, $25), $26), $27)
  OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE($28, $29), $30)
),
bounded_ids AS (
  SELECT array_agg(id ORDER BY id) AS player_ids
    FROM bounded_players
),
projections AS (
  SELECT projection.*
    FROM bounded_ids AS ids
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.get_league_projection_rows(
      p_league_id,
      p_season_year,
      (timezone($31, now()))::date,
      $32,
      ids.player_ids,
      $33,
      $34
    ) AS projection
   WHERE ids.player_ids IS NOT NULL
),
fantasy_averages AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT player_id, avg_fantasy_points
    FROM private.trade_value_fantasy_averages(p_league_id,p_season_year,p_player_ids)
)
SELECT
  player.id AS player_id,
  player.display_name,
  player.nba_team,
  player.position,
  player.eligible_positions,
  player.injury_status,
  player.years_exp,
  player.headshot_url,
  player.nba_id,
  player.dynasty_ranking_id,
  player.five_year_rank,
  player.three_year_rank,
  player.rookie_rank,
  player.rank_change,
  player.age,
  player.ranking_source,
  player.ranking_fetched_at,
  average.games_played,
  average.avg_points,
  average.avg_rebounds,
  average.avg_assists,
  average.avg_steals,
  average.avg_blocks,
  average.avg_three_pointers_made,
  average.avg_turnovers,
  average.avg_field_goals_made,
  average.avg_field_goals_attempted,
  average.avg_free_throws_made,
  average.avg_free_throws_attempted,
  fantasy.avg_fantasy_points,
  projection.projection_fantasy_points,
  projection.projection_fetched_at,
  projection.projection_source,
  player.trade_value
FROM bounded_players AS player
LEFT JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages AS average
  ON average.player_id = player.id
 AND average.season_year = p_season_year
LEFT JOIN fantasy_averages AS fantasy
  ON fantasy.player_id = player.id
LEFT JOIN projections AS projection ON projection.player_id = player.id
ORDER BY player.five_year_rank NULLS LAST, player.display_name, player.id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(player) || CASE WHEN market.id IS NULL THEN $35::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object(
    $36, market.id,
    $37, market.source_rank,
    $38, market.rank_change,
    $39, market.age,
    $40, market.source,
    $41, market.fetched_at,
    $42, market.trade_value
  ) END ORDER BY player.player_id), $43::jsonb)
  FROM input_rows player
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ranking.id, ranking.source_rank, ranking.rank_change, ranking.age, ranking.source, ranking.fetched_at, ranking.trade_value
      FROM public.dynasty_rankings ranking
     WHERE ranking.player_id = player.player_id AND ranking.source = $44
     ORDER BY ranking.fetched_at DESC, ranking.source_rank, ranking.id
     LIMIT $45
  ) market ON $46)

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN p_view IN ($8, $9, $10) THEN p_view ELSE $11 END AS view_name,
    COALESCE(p_game_date, (timezone($12, now()))::date) AS game_date,
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, $13), $14), $15) AS page_limit,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, $16), $17) AS page_offset
),
league AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    scoring_settings,
    (
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$18)::numeric, $19) <> $20 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$21)::numeric, $22) <> $23 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$24)::numeric, $25) <> $26 OR
      COALESCE((scoring_settings->>$27)::numeric, $28) <> $29
    ) AS uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  FROM public.leagues
  WHERE id = p_league_id
),
week_ctx AS (
  SELECT sw.week_number, sw.week_start, sw.week_end
  FROM args
  JOIN public.season_weeks sw
    ON sw.season_year = p_season_year
   AND sw.week_start <= args.game_date
   AND sw.week_end >= args.game_date
  LIMIT $30
),
base_players AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    COALESCE(p.display_name, concat_ws($31, p.first_name, p.last_name)) AS display_name,
    p.nba_team,
    p.position::text AS "position",
    ARRAY(SELECT pos::text FROM unnest(p.eligible_positions) AS pos) AS eligible_positions,
    p.injury_status,
    p.headshot_url,
    p.nba_id
  FROM public.players p
  WHERE p_player_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(p_player_ids)
),
regular_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time, status, started_at
  FROM public.nba_games
  WHERE season_year = p_season_year AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(nba_game_id)
),
upcoming_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ng.id, ng.game_date, ng.home_team, ng.away_team, ng.game_time
  FROM args
  JOIN regular_games ng
    ON ng.game_date >= args.game_date
   AND ng.status NOT IN ($32, $33)
   AND (ng.game_time IS NULL OR ng.game_time > now())
   AND (ng.started_at IS NULL OR ng.started_at > now())
),
team_next_games AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (teams.nba_team) teams.nba_team, g.game_date, g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_time
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT nba_team FROM base_players WHERE nba_team IS NOT NULL) teams
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT home_team AS nba_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
    UNION ALL
    SELECT away_team, id, game_date, home_team, away_team, game_time FROM upcoming_games
  ) g ON g.nba_team = teams.nba_team
  ORDER BY teams.nba_team, g.game_date ASC, g.game_time ASC NULLS LAST, g.id ASC
),
next_games AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    g.game_date AS next_game_date,
    CASE
      WHEN g.home_team = bp.nba_team THEN $34 || COALESCE(g.away_team, $35)
      WHEN g.away_team = bp.nba_team THEN $36 || COALESCE(g.home_team, $37)
      ELSE $38
    END AS next_game_opponent,
    g.game_time AS next_game_time
  FROM base_players bp
  LEFT JOIN team_next_games g ON g.nba_team = bp.nba_team
),
week_game_counts AS (
  SELECT
    bp.id AS player_id,
    COUNT(ng.id)::int AS scheduled_games
  FROM base_players bp
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON $39
  JOIN public.nba_games ng
    ON ng.season_year = p_season_year
   AND ng.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND public.is_regular_season_game_id(ng.nba_game_id)
   AND bp.nba_team IS NOT NULL
   AND (ng.home_team = bp.nba_team OR ng.away_team = bp.nba_team)
  GROUP BY bp.id
),
latest_daily_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $40
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $41
   AND latest_run.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND latest_run.status = $42
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $43
),
latest_weekly_avg_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $44
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $45
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $46
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $47
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $48
),
latest_weekly_total_run AS (
  SELECT latest_run.id
  FROM args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $49
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs latest_run
    ON latest_run.source = $50
   AND latest_run.projection_type = $51
   AND latest_run.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number IS NULL OR latest_run.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND latest_run.status = $52
   AND latest_run.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY latest_run.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, latest_run.started_at DESC, latest_run.id DESC
  LIMIT $53
),
daily_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $54::text AS projection_source,
    $55::text AS projection_source_label,
    $56::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $57::numeric, $58::numeric, $59::numeric, $60::numeric, $61::numeric, $62::numeric,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $63 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $64 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $65
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $66
   AND r.match_status = $67
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.projection_date = args.game_date
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $68
  JOIN latest_daily_run ldr
    ON ldr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $69
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = $70
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $71 THEN $72
      ELSE $73
    END::text AS projection_source,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $74 THEN $75
      ELSE $76
    END::text AS projection_source_label,
    CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $77 THEN $78
      ELSE $79
    END::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points * m.games_multiplier,
      r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      r.assists * m.games_multiplier,
      r.steals * m.games_multiplier,
      r.blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      $80::numeric,
      $81::numeric,
      $82::numeric,
      $83::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $84 AND m.games_multiplier > $85 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $86) >= $87)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $88) >= $89)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $90) >= $91)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $92) >= $93)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $94) >= $95)::int
        ) >= $96 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $97 THEN $98::numeric
        ELSE $99::numeric
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $100 AND m.games_multiplier > $101 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $102) >= $103)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $104) >= $105)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $106) >= $107)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $108) >= $109)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $110) >= $111)::int
        ) >= $112 THEN m.games_multiplier
        WHEN args.view_name = $113 THEN $114::numeric
        ELSE $115::numeric
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    r.points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    r.steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $116 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE r.games_played END AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $117 AS projection_is_fresh,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $118 THEN $119 ELSE $120 END AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $121
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $122
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $123
   AND r.match_status = $124
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $125
  JOIN latest_weekly_avg_run lwar
    ON lwar.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $126
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = r.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $127 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(r.games_played, $128), wgc.scheduled_games, $129)::numeric
      ELSE $130::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  WHERE args.view_name IN ($131, $132, $133)
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
weekly_total_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.player_id)
    r.player_id,
    $134::text AS projection_source,
    $135::text AS projection_source_label,
    $136::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
      $137::numeric, $138::numeric, $139::numeric, $140::numeric,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $141) > $142 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $143) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $144) >= $145)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $146) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $147) >= $148)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $149) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $150) >= $151)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $152) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $153) >= $154)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $155) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $156) >= $157)::int
        ) >= $158 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $159
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.games_played, $160) > $161 AND (
          (COALESCE(r.points, $162) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $163) >= $164)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.rebounds, $165) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $166) >= $167)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.assists, $168) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $169) >= $170)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.steals, $171) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $172) >= $173)::int +
          (COALESCE(r.blocks, $174) / NULLIF(r.games_played, $175) >= $176)::int
        ) >= $177 THEN r.games_played::numeric
        ELSE $178
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    r.minutes AS projection_minutes,
    r.points AS projection_points,
    r.rebounds AS projection_rebounds,
    r.assists AS projection_assists,
    r.steals AS projection_steals,
    r.blocks AS projection_blocks,
    r.three_pointers_made AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    r.turnovers AS projection_turnovers,
    r.games_played AS projection_games_played,
    r.field_goal_pct AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    r.free_throw_pct AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    r.source_status AS projection_status,
    r.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    r.projection_date,
    r.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $179 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $180 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $181
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $182
  JOIN public.fantasypros_projection_rows r
    ON r.projection_type = $183
   AND r.match_status = $184
   AND r.player_id IS NOT NULL
   AND r.season_year = p_season_year
   AND (wc.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number IS NULL OR r.week_number = wc.week_number)
   AND r.fetched_at >= now() - interval $185
  JOIN latest_weekly_total_run lwtr
    ON lwtr.id = r.run_id
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = r.player_id
  JOIN public.projection_sync_runs psr
    ON psr.id = r.run_id
   AND psr.status = $186
   AND psr.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  WHERE args.view_name = $187
    AND NOT l.uses_fantasypros_unsupported_scoring
  ORDER BY r.player_id, r.week_number DESC NULLS LAST, r.fetched_at DESC, r.run_id DESC
),
internal_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (pp.player_id)
    pp.player_id,
    $188::text AS projection_source,
    $189::text AS projection_source_label,
    $190::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      pp.projected_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $191 THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_double_doubles, $192) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_double_doubles
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN args.view_name = $193 THEN COALESCE(pp.projected_triple_doubles, $194) * m.games_multiplier
        ELSE pp.projected_triple_doubles
      END,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    pp.projected_minutes * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    pp.projected_stat_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    pp.projected_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    pp.projected_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    pp.projected_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    pp.projected_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    pp.projected_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    pp.projected_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $195 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE $196::int END AS projection_games_played,
    $197::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    $198::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $199::text AS projection_status,
    pp.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    $200::date AS projection_date,
    pp.week_number AS projection_week_number,
    $201 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $202 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN week_ctx wc ON $203
  JOIN league l ON $204
  JOIN public.player_projections pp
    ON pp.season_year = p_season_year
   AND pp.week_number = wc.week_number
   AND pp.projected_stat_points IS NOT NULL
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = pp.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = pp.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $205 THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, $206)::numeric
      ELSE $207::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
  ORDER BY pp.player_id, pp.fetched_at DESC
),
season_avg_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    avg.player_id,
    $208::text AS projection_source,
    $209::text AS projection_source_label,
    $210::text AS projection_view,
    public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
      avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_field_goals_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_made * m.games_multiplier,
      avg.avg_free_throws_attempted * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, $211) > $212
        THEN COALESCE(avg.double_doubles, $213)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE $214 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      (CASE WHEN COALESCE(avg.games_played, $215) > $216
        THEN COALESCE(avg.triple_doubles, $217)::numeric / avg.games_played
        ELSE $218 END) * m.games_multiplier,
      l.scoring_settings
    ) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    avg.avg_minutes_played * m.games_multiplier AS projection_minutes,
    avg.avg_points * m.games_multiplier AS projection_points,
    avg.avg_rebounds * m.games_multiplier AS projection_rebounds,
    avg.avg_assists * m.games_multiplier AS projection_assists,
    avg.avg_steals * m.games_multiplier AS projection_steals,
    avg.avg_blocks * m.games_multiplier AS projection_blocks,
    avg.avg_three_pointers_made * m.games_multiplier AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    avg.avg_turnovers * m.games_multiplier AS projection_turnovers,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name = $219 THEN m.games_multiplier::int ELSE avg.games_played::int END AS projection_games_played,
    $220::numeric AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    $221::numeric AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $222::text AS projection_status,
    $223::timestamptz AS projection_fetched_at,
    $224::date AS projection_date,
    $225::int AS projection_week_number,
    $226 AS projection_is_fresh,
    $227 AS priority
  FROM args
  JOIN league l ON $228
  JOIN public.mv_player_season_averages avg
    ON avg.season_year = p_season_year
  JOIN base_players projected_player
    ON projected_player.id = avg.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc
    ON wgc.player_id = avg.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN args.view_name = $229 THEN COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games, $230)::numeric
      ELSE $231::numeric
    END AS games_multiplier
  ) m
),
candidate_union AS (
  SELECT * FROM daily_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_total_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM weekly_avg_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM internal_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM season_avg_candidates
),
fallback_best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cu.player_id) cu.*
  FROM candidate_union cu
  ORDER BY cu.player_id, cu.priority ASC, cu.projection_fetched_at DESC NULLS LAST
),
sleeper_games AS (
  SELECT r.*, public.projection_stat_fantasy_points(
    r.points, r.rebounds, r.assists, r.steals, r.blocks, r.three_pointers_made, r.turnovers,
    r.field_goals_made, r.field_goals_attempted, r.free_throws_made, r.free_throws_attempted,
    r.double_doubles, r.triple_doubles, l.scoring_settings
  ) AS fantasy_points, r.team IS DISTINCT FROM bp.nba_team AS prior_team_game
  FROM public.sleeper_projection_rows r
  JOIN base_players bp ON bp.id = r.player_id
  LEFT JOIN next_games ng ON ng.player_id=bp.id
  JOIN league l ON $232
  CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN week_ctx wc ON $233
  WHERE r.season_year = p_season_year
    AND (r.game_date<(now() AT TIME ZONE $234)::date OR r.team=bp.nba_team)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT $235 FROM (
      SELECT game_date,home_team AS team,away_team AS opponent FROM regular_games
      UNION ALL SELECT game_date,away_team,home_team FROM regular_games
    ) g WHERE g.game_date=r.game_date AND g.team=r.team AND g.opponent=r.opponent)
    AND (args.view_name = $236 AND r.game_date = COALESCE(ng.next_game_date,args.game_date)
      OR args.view_name <> $237 AND r.week_number = wc.week_number)
),
sleeper_totals AS (
  SELECT player_id, count(*)::integer AS games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE prior_team_game)::integer AS prior_team_games,
    sum(fantasy_points) AS fantasy_points,
    sum(points) AS points, sum(rebounds) AS rebounds, sum(assists) AS assists,
    sum(steals) AS steals, sum(blocks) AS blocks, sum(three_pointers_made) AS three_pointers_made,
    sum(turnovers) AS turnovers, sum(minutes) AS minutes,
    $238 * sum(field_goals_made) / NULLIF(sum(field_goals_attempted),$239) AS field_goal_pct,
    $240 * sum(free_throws_made) / NULLIF(sum(free_throws_attempted),$241) AS free_throw_pct,
    max(fetched_at) AS fetched_at, min(game_date) AS game_date, min(week_number) AS week_number
  FROM sleeper_games GROUP BY player_id
),
sleeper_candidates AS (
  SELECT s.player_id, $242::text AS projection_source, $243::text AS projection_source_label,
    args.view_name AS projection_view,
    ROUND((s.fantasy_points + COALESCE(b.projection_fantasy_points * m.missing_fraction,$244)) / m.divisor,$245) AS projection_fantasy_points,
    (s.minutes + COALESCE(b.projection_minutes * m.missing_fraction,$246)) / m.divisor AS projection_minutes,
    (s.points + COALESCE(b.projection_points * m.missing_fraction,$247)) / m.divisor AS projection_points,
    (s.rebounds + COALESCE(b.projection_rebounds * m.missing_fraction,$248)) / m.divisor AS projection_rebounds,
    (s.assists + COALESCE(b.projection_assists * m.missing_fraction,$249)) / m.divisor AS projection_assists,
    (s.steals + COALESCE(b.projection_steals * m.missing_fraction,$250)) / m.divisor AS projection_steals,
    (s.blocks + COALESCE(b.projection_blocks * m.missing_fraction,$251)) / m.divisor AS projection_blocks,
    (s.three_pointers_made + COALESCE(b.projection_three_pointers_made * m.missing_fraction,$252)) / m.divisor AS projection_three_pointers_made,
    (s.turnovers + COALESCE(b.projection_turnovers * m.missing_fraction,$253)) / m.divisor AS projection_turnovers,
    s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $254 END AS projection_games_played,
    (COALESCE(s.field_goal_pct,$255)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_field_goal_pct,$256)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_field_goal_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $257 END,$258) AS projection_field_goal_pct,
    (COALESCE(s.free_throw_pct,$259)*s.games + COALESCE(b.projection_free_throw_pct,$260)*m.missing_games) /
      NULLIF(s.games + CASE WHEN b.projection_free_throw_pct IS NOT NULL THEN m.missing_games ELSE $261 END,$262) AS projection_free_throw_pct,
    $263::text AS projection_status, s.fetched_at AS projection_fetched_at,
    CASE WHEN args.view_name=$264 THEN s.game_date ELSE $265::date END AS projection_date,
    s.week_number AS projection_week_number, s.fetched_at>=now()-interval $266 AS projection_is_fresh, $267 AS priority
  FROM sleeper_totals s CROSS JOIN args
  LEFT JOIN fallback_best b ON b.player_id=s.player_id
  LEFT JOIN week_game_counts wgc ON wgc.player_id=s.player_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN args.view_name=$268 THEN $269 ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(wgc.scheduled_games,$270)+s.prior_team_games-s.games,$271) END AS missing_games
  ) missing
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT missing.missing_games,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$272 THEN missing.missing_games::numeric / NULLIF(b.projection_games_played,$273)
        ELSE missing.missing_games::numeric END AS missing_fraction,
      CASE WHEN args.view_name=$274 THEN s.games + CASE WHEN b.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN missing.missing_games ELSE $275 END
        ELSE $276 END::numeric AS divisor
  ) m
),
best AS (
  SELECT * FROM sleeper_candidates
  UNION ALL SELECT b.* FROM fallback_best b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT $277 FROM sleeper_candidates s WHERE s.player_id=b.player_id)
)

(
  WITH context AS MATERIALIZED (

    FROM public.trades trade JOIN public.leagues league ON league.id=trade.league_id AND league.deleted_at IS NULL

    (now() AT TIME ZONE $15)::date,

WITH rounded AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT stats.player_id,round(avg(round(COALESCE(stats.points*weights.points,$25) +
        COALESCE(stats.rebounds*weights.rebounds,$26) +
        COALESCE(stats.assists*weights.assists,$27) +
        COALESCE(stats.steals*weights.steals,$28) +
        COALESCE(stats.blocks*weights.blocks,$29) +
        COALESCE(stats.turnovers*weights.turnovers,$30) +
        COALESCE(stats.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made,$31) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made,$32) +
        COALESCE(stats.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted,$33) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made,$34) +
        COALESCE(stats.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted,$35) +
        CASE WHEN stats.double_double THEN COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,$36) ELSE $37 END +
        CASE WHEN stats.triple_double THEN COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,$38) ELSE $39 END,$40)),$41) AS average
    FROM unnest(game_ids) AS game(id)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT stats.* FROM public.player_game_stats stats
      WHERE stats.game_id=game.id AND stats.player_id=ANY(rounded_players)
        AND stats.season_year=p_season_year AND NOT stats.did_not_play
      OFFSET $42
    ) stats
    GROUP BY stats.player_id
  )
  SELECT totals.player_id,CASE WHEN totals.player_id=ANY(rounded_players) THEN rounded.average
    ELSE round((totals.points*weights.points +
      totals.rebounds*weights.rebounds +
      totals.assists*weights.assists +
      totals.steals*weights.steals +
      totals.blocks*weights.blocks +
      totals.turnovers*weights.turnovers +
      totals.three_pointers_made*weights.three_pointers_made +
      totals.field_goals_made*weights.field_goals_made +
      totals.field_goals_attempted*weights.field_goals_attempted +
      totals.free_throws_made*weights.free_throws_made +
      totals.free_throws_attempted*weights.free_throws_attempted +
      CASE WHEN totals.double_double>$43 THEN totals.double_double*COALESCE(weights.double_double::numeric,$44) ELSE $45 END +
      CASE WHEN totals.triple_double>$46 THEN totals.triple_double*COALESCE(weights.triple_double::numeric,$47) ELSE $48 END)/NULLIF(totals.games_played,$49),$50) END
    FROM analytics.player_season_totals totals LEFT JOIN rounded ON rounded.player_id=totals.player_id
    WHERE totals.season_year=p_season_year AND (p_player_ids IS NULL OR totals.player_id=ANY(p_player_ids))
